questions.question: Let a = √7 + √10 and b = √11 + √6. Which is greater?
questions.questionHtml: Let a = √7 + √10 and b = √11 + √6. Which is greater?
questions.solution:
a = √7 + √10
b = √11 + √6

Compare by squaring both sides:

a² = (√7 + √10)²
a² = 7 + 10 + 2√70
a² = 17 + 2√70

b² = (√11 + √6)²
b² = 11 + 6 + 2√66
b² = 17 + 2√66

Now compare:

a² = 17 + 2√70
b² = 17 + 2√66

Since √70 > √66,
So, 2√70 > 2√66

Therefore,

a² > b²

Hence,

a > b

Correct Answer: (b) a > b

questions.question: The ratio of boys to girls in a school is 5 : 3. If 50 more girls join the school, the new ratio of boys to girls becomes 5 : 4. What is the total number of students in the school initially?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of boys to girls in a school is 5 : 3. If 50 more girls join the school, the new ratio of boys to girls becomes 5 : 4. What is the total number of students in the school initially?
questions.solution:
Initial ratio = Boys : Girls = 5 : 3
New ratio = Boys : Girls = 5 : 4

Boys ratio is same = 5

Girls increased from 3 to 4 parts

1 part = 50 girls

Total initial students = 5 + 3 = 8 parts

8 parts = 8 × 50 = 400

questions.question: A, B, and C can complete a piece of work in 20, 30, and 60 days respectively. A works on all days, while B and C assist A every third day. In how many days will the work be completed?
questions.questionHtml: A, B, and C can complete a piece of work in 20, 30, and 60 days respectively. A works on all days, while B and C assist A every third day. In how many days will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
LCM of 20, 30, 60 = 60 units

A = 3 units/day
B = 2 units/day
C = 1 unit/day

In 3 days:

A works daily = 3 × 3 = 9 units
B + C work on 3rd day = 2 + 1 = 3 units

Total work in 3 days = 12 units

So,

60 ÷ 12 = 5 cycles

5 × 3 = 15 days

questions.question: The ratio of the efficiencies of two workers, A and B, is 3 : 4. If A can complete a task in 20 days, how many days will B take to complete the same task alone?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of the efficiencies of two workers, A and B, is 3 : 4. If A can complete a task in 20 days, how many days will B take to complete the same task alone?
questions.solution:
Efficiency ratio A : B = 3 : 4

Time ratio A : B = 4 : 3

A takes 20 days = 4 parts

So, 1 part = 5 days

B takes 3 parts = 3 × 5 = 15 days

questions.question: The corresponding sides of two similar triangles are in the ratio 4:7. If the area of the smaller triangle is 32 sq. cm, find the area of the larger triangle.
questions.questionHtml: The corresponding sides of two similar triangles are in the ratio 4:7. If the area of the smaller triangle is 32 sq. cm, find the area of the larger triangle.
questions.solution:
Side ratio = 4 : 7

Area ratio = 4² : 7² = 16 : 49

Smaller triangle area = 32 sq. cm

16 parts = 32
1 part = 2

Larger triangle area = 49 × 2 = 98 sq. cm
